revision_note: v6 (task 1.0.0) scores the Windows I/O completion port contract described by instruction.md. The five groups are programmatic-only and their weights sum to 1.0; every group is gated by required cases declared in tests/required_testcases.json, so the score stays binary and never becomes partial credit. Case granularity is 14 (F2P 4 / P2P 10): the four F2P cases are the ones the shipped defective module provably fails (a completion that had already reached the port being relabelled by a later register(), duplicate/lost delivery under concurrent take(), a missed deadline degrading the pool, and a non-overlapped object being accepted); the remaining ten hold under both the shipped module and the reference and are kept as the regression surface. The mechanism anchors for these groups are recorded in metadata/windows_mechanism.json.
